description.value: Verandah Cafe is a boutique beachside cafe on Marine Drive in White Rock, set in a historic rustic beach-house property overlooking East Beach near Semiahmoo Park. The menu draws on the culinary heritage of the Indian subcontinent, offering Indian-inspired street food, fusion dishes, samosas, masala chai, and locally roasted fair-trade espresso. It opened in April 2018 as a community-minded gathering space and has hosted cooking classes, fitness events, and mental health talks.
